follow_up_packets.what: Wire bsp_game.exe to run the ring scan instead of recording it. src/game_hosts_ship_ai.cpp lines 837-853 record 009E76D0, 009E5E90 and 009E6A90 with the note 'the four unread scorers'; three of the four are now read and the fourth (009E5DA0) is a thin adapter around one host call. The binding needs a ShipAiRingScanHost whose probe_hit_0041b4e0 can answer, which is the next item.

unit->vtable[218h] (009E66EB), 00417B10 (009E673E) and 0041B4E0 (009E6808): the object the obstacle probe is cast against, the start-point adjustment with a 3.0f clearance, and the segment query that returns the hit point. Without these the probe always reports clear water and every slot scores 1.0.

0095EB40 (009E5DC4) and the producer of the 17-dword block at nested+127Ch..12BFh. 0095EB40 is in the vehicle-class cluster and has two other callers, 0095F080 and 009E6240. It is what fills slot+18h and therefore, through 009E7FC0's mode-0 normalisation, slot+2Ch: the largest of the five ring weights.

Define the four one-instruction accessors in the gap 009E5E30-009E5E8F that Ghidra has no functions for: 009E5E50 (LEA EAX,[ECX+1228h], the approach point), 009E5E60 (FLD [ECX+11E0h], the goal range) and the two this packet documents. tools/ghidra_define_function.py with the ranges in the no_ghidra_function table.

uncertainties: The probe-length ramp at 009E67AA gives a slot pointing at the reference bearing a zero-length probe and a slot 120 degrees away the full range, so a slot aligned with the goal is never blocked. That is what the listing says (x0 = 20 deg with y0 = 0 at 009E67A1 and 009E679D, x1 = 120 deg with y1 = 1 at 009E6791 and 009E678B); it is reproduced, not corrected, and no run-time evidence was available to test it.

00CE3D10 is one pooled double, 0.2f widened. 009E76DA uses it as the wobble-phase rate and 009E692B as the arc-cost slope. The header carries one constant for both; whether the source had one constant or two is not recoverable.
009E6870's side and span arguments come from 009E6E80's tail, whose two curve arms are projected as host calls, so the arc geometry is only as good as those.

The seventeen dwords 009E5DA0 forwards are copied with REP MOVSD, so only the five words this packet saw used as floats (5, 10, 11, 12, 13) are known to be floats. The producer of the block beyond nested+1290h/1294h/1298h is unknown.

nested+11E8h, the committed slot 009E5E90's ring walk starts from, is still written by no routine any packet has read; 009E5530 zeroes it at 009E561F. The walk therefore always starts at slot 0 in the projection.
